body.processed:
An estimate of the shortest distance of vesicles to synaptic cleft is computed in 3D for serial section TEM. Unfortunately the the authors do not provide an implementation.

Method:
1. Bias correction for inhomogene lighting
2. Image registration of TEM sections / stacks
3. Detection of vesicles & synaptic cleft (semi-automatic)
4. Compute distances in 3D
